parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.stem: Fluorine-18 ($^{18}_{9}\text{F}$) is an isotope that decays to an isotope of oxygen (O) by the emission of a $\beta^{+}$ particle.
parts.text:
Complete the nuclear equation for the decay, including all the particles involved.
$$^{18}_{9}\text{F} \rightarrow$$

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text: A quark in the fluorine-18 nucleus changes flavour during the decay. State this change of flavour.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.stem: A hadron has a charge of $-2e$, where $e$ is the elementary charge.
parts.text: State and explain whether the hadron is a meson or a baryon.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: State a possible quark composition for the hadron.
